table.title: [Opium, Morphia and Cocaine Seized by the Chinese Custom Houses, 1917-1920]
table.caption_extra: Customs Seizures — introduced in the text: "The quantities of opium, morphia, and cocaine seized by the Chinese Custom Houses during the last four years are given below :—"
transcriber_notes: Each opium figure in Lb. is followed by '=' and its equivalent in Tons, Cwt., Qrs., Lb.; the '=' signs are omitted from the cells.
Totals for Opium Lb. (192,146), Morphia (1,321) and Cocaine (475) reconcile.

Tons/Cwt./Qrs./Lb. total (85 15 2 10) is in mixed units (1 ton = 20 cwt, 1 cwt = 4 qrs, 1 qr = 28 lb) so simple column sums (84, 33, 8, 66) differ; with carries (66 lb = 2 qrs 10 lb; 10 qrs = 2 cwt 2 qrs; 35 cwt = 1 ton 15 cwt) the total 85 tons 15 cwt 2 qrs 10 lb reconciles, and equals 192,146 lb.
